You can use Rovo to explain and troubleshoot Jira permissions. Open Rovo Chat and enter /manage-jira-permissions, then tell Rovo what problem you’re trying to solve, or ask for a rundown on your current permissions setup.
Work with external collaborators using guest roles
If you need to give external collaborators limited access to Jira without a full license, you can invite them as guests. Guests are free, non-billable, and restricted to a single space per site — with a fixed set of permissions that can't be expanded through permission schemes or space roles. How to invite and manage guests in Jira
